facts.anchor: It is Sunday, noon, and it has been thirty-four hours since Catherine has seen
facts.fact: 周日正午，Catherine 已有三十四个小时没见到女儿、也没和女儿说话。

facts.anchor: She had called the gallery ahead of time to book a meeting with the artist.
facts.fact: 她提前打电话到画廊，预约与这位艺术家会面，对外称是杂志采访。

facts.anchor: “There is no journalist. I’m the one who called. I’m here because we slept together.”
facts.fact: 她当面说明没有记者，电话是她自己打的，她来是因为两人曾上过床。

facts.anchor:
“She’s twenty. She’s yours.”


A pause. “I doubt it.”
facts.fact: 她说女儿二十岁、是他的；他停顿后回了一句「我不信」。

facts.anchor: “That’s me,” Catherine says, pointing to the painting of her on the wall.
facts.fact: 她指着墙上那幅画着她的画，说画中的人就是她。

facts.anchor: “I want nothing from you. I need nothing from you.”
facts.fact: 她声明不向他要任何东西，也不需要他任何东西。

facts.anchor:
She’s not yours. She’s mine.”


Her words hang there in front of him.
facts.fact: 她说女儿不是他的、是她的，这句话就悬在他面前。

facts.anchor: and with that, Catherine leaves. She leaves him standing there. She doesn’t look back.
facts.fact: 说完她就走，把他一个人留在原地，没有回头。
